rows.label: tlk70000047_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Bless me, I never thought this day
would come. It's like a dream.

rows.label: tlk70000047_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I shall make the most of every day
with my daughter from now on. I don't
have words to thank your lordships.

rows.label: tlk70000047_05_msg0003
rows.name:
But since my daughter's
illness was cured lately, I
find myself wanting more...

rows.label: tlk70000047_05_msg0004
rows.name:
I want to stay with her longer... I
want to live together longer...

rows.label: tlk70000047_05_msg0005
rows.name:
But now that Iira has awakened, I know
that future is in danger.

rows.label: tlk70000047_05_msg0007
rows.name:
Please protect this child's future...
and the future of the people of Iira!
